SELECT fish_date_doy AS doy, landing, boat, yt, anglers, ROUND(yt/anglers,3) AS rate
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 155 AND 182 AND cls='three_quarter'
ORDER BY doy
SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 8
